cost_notes: Free of charge, no registration, no key.
historical_coverage: trader-level presence tables from ~2016; aggregate OTS from 2013 in this API
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: this is the only VERIFIED OPEN company-level trade channel found. /Trader?$filter=contains(CompanyName,'MEDTRONIC') returned real named traders (MEDTRONIC LIMITED, MEDTRONIC VASCULAR GALWAY ..., MEDTRONIC INTERNATIONAL TRADING SARL); PHILIPS/DRAEGER/MINDRAY also resolved.

CATEGORY WARNING: this is company-level PRESENCE data, NOT a bill of lading. Trade/YearlyTrade join TraderId x CommodityId x MonthId, and contain NO values, NO quantities, NO partners and NO consignment identity. Do not treat it as shipment-value data.
The aggregate series in the same service is the OTS entity (Value, NetMass, SuppUnit by month x flow x commodity x country x port) - that part is trade_aggregate, not shipment.

Company names are raw declarant strings with heavy noise ('PHILIPS PHILIPHS', 'MEDTRONIC VASCULAR GALWAY UNLIMITEDCOMPANY'), so linking must stay at exact_alias/candidate and be manually reviewed; the shared alias table also matches non-medical Philips entities (e.g. PHILIPS IN LIGHTING LTD).
Several non-UK traders share the same HMRC address/postcode 'AB10 1ZP' (HM Revenue and Customs, Ruby House, Aberdeen), so address is NOT a usable disambiguator for them.
Commodity entity rejects startswith(Cn8Code,...) with a runtime error page; use CommoditySearch (Hs2/Hs4/Hs6) instead.
UK only: this says nothing about US, EU, Chinese or Japanese firms' trade.
licence: HMRC published trade statistics; presumed Open Government Licence v3.0 (to confirm against the service terms)
rate_limits: undocumented OData service; no key-based throttling observed
research_value: The only open, verified, company-level trade signal available in this round: it can show WHICH UK-registered entity (including Medtronic/Philips/Draeger/Mindray UK subsidiaries) traded WHICH CN8 commodity in WHICH month, import or export. That is a genuine firm-level activity clock - presence, not volume - and it must be presented as such, alongside (never instead of) aggregate statistics.
timestamp_fields: no published-at field in the API -> HMRC's publication lag must be documented separately and the record kept out of lead-time claims
update_frequency: monthly (OTS trade statistics are published in arrears)
